part6.title: 辦公室門禁系統升級通知
part6.header:
TO: All Taipei Headquarters Staff
FROM: Facilities Management Department
DATE: May 12
SUBJECT: Security Badge Upgrade
part6.body:
Starting Monday, May 19, our building will transition to a new contactless access control system designed to enhance workplace security. All full-time and contract employees must visit the Security Desk on the first floor before May 16 to have their new smart badges [1].

Please bring your current employee ID card when picking up your replacement badge. [2] Without an updated badge, staff members will need to sign in at the reception lobby each morning.

[3] the system upgrade is completed, the old magnetic cards will be deactivated automatically. If your department has new interns joining after May 19, managers should submit an access request form through the HR portal at least three business days in [4].

questions.explanation: 使役動詞 have + 事物（their new smart badges）+ 過去分詞（p.p.），表示「讓新智慧識別證被核發」，故選過去分詞 issued。

options: The cafeteria menu will also feature seasonal items next week.
The entire registration process takes less than five minutes.
Parking fees have been waived for overnight visitors.
We regret to announce the cancellation of the annual picnic.
questions.explanation: 新制 Part 6 必考句子插入題！前句提醒領取新卡時攜帶舊員工證，後句提醒沒換卡的後果，中間銜接「整個換證流程只需不到五分鐘（The entire registration process takes less than five minutes.）」語意最連貫自然。
後方為完整子句 the system upgrade is completed，需使用時間連接詞 Once（一旦…），表示「一旦系統升級完成，舊磁卡將自動停用」。During 與 Despite 為介系詞。
多益商務必考片語：in advance（提前、事先），at least three business days in advance 表示「至少提前三個工作天」。

part6.title: 訂單延誤致歉與退款說明
part6.header:
TO: kevin.wu@brightmail.tw
FROM: support@nordichome.com
SUBJECT: Update on Your Order #NH-84920

Dear Mr. Wu,

Thank you for contacting Nordic Home Customer Care regarding your recent purchase of the Oslo Standing Desk. We sincerely apologize for the delay in shipping your order. Due to an unexpectedly high volume of holiday orders, our regional warehouse experienced a brief backlog [5] the past week.

We are pleased to inform you that your package was handed over to the courier this morning and is scheduled to arrive by Thursday, November 14. [6]

As a token of our appreciation for your patience, we have [7] the NT$450 express delivery fee to your original payment method. You should see the credit appear on your monthly statement [8] five business days.

Warm regards,
Hannah Lin
Customer Experience Specialist

questions.explanation: over the past week（在過去一週期間）是多益常見的時間片語，表示在過去一段時間內發生的積壓狀況。

options: You can monitor its delivery status anytime using the tracking number below.
Our furniture showroom is currently closed for winter inventory.
Please let us know if you would like to apply for a sales position.
The assembly instructions were accidentally omitted from last year's catalog.
questions.explanation: 前句剛說明包裹已交由快遞寄出並預計週四抵達，緊接著補充「您可以隨時使用下方的物流追蹤編號查詢配送進度」，最符合客服物流通知的上下文邏輯。
依前後文「為感謝您的耐心，我們已將 450 元急件運費『退還』至您的原付款方式」，且下句提到 credit appear on your statement（入帳／退款顯示於帳單），故選 refunded（退款）。
within five business days（五個工作天內）是客服、金融與退款書信中出現率極高的時間介系詞片語。

part6.title: 綠能科技推出新一代太陽能儲能系統
part6.header:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
SunPeak Energy Unveils Compact Commercial Storage Unit
part6.body:
TAIPEI — SunPeak Energy announced today the commercial launch of its VoltBox Pro, a high-capacity battery system designed specifically for mid-sized factories and retail chains. Measuring 30 percent smaller than [9] models, the unit fits easily into existing utility rooms without costly structural modifications.

According to Chief Engineer Dr. David Hsu, the VoltBox Pro uses advanced thermal regulation to extend battery lifespan by up to five years. [10] Consequently, commercial clients can lower their peak-hour electricity expenses while maintaining reliable backup power during grid outages.

Initial installations are already underway at twelve industrial parks across Taiwan. [11], the company plans to enter the Japanese and Australian markets in the third quarter. Businesses interested in scheduling an on-site energy [12] may register on SunPeak's official website.

questions.explanation: 空格位於名詞 models 前方，需要形容詞修飾名詞，comparable models 意為「同等級的／可相比擬的機型」。

options: Residential homeowners must apply for a separate municipal permit.
Several competitors recently relocated their headquarters to Europe.
Dr. Hsu will retire from the engineering department next spring.
It also charges twice as fast as conventional lithium storage banks.
questions.explanation: 前句介紹技術優勢（先進溫控延長電池壽命五年），後句以 Consequently（因此）總結企業客戶能降低尖峰電費與保有穩定備援電力，中間填入「它的充電速度也是傳統鋰電儲能櫃的兩倍」最連貫。
前句說台灣十二座工業區已展開首批安裝，本句接著說公司第三季還計畫進軍日本與澳洲市場，屬於遞進補充關係，故選 Furthermore（此外、更進一步）。
空格前有冠詞 an 與複合修飾語 on-site energy，後方缺少核心名詞，on-site energy assessment 意為「現場能源評估」。

part6.docType: 系統維護通知（IT Service Notice）
part6.title: 雲端薪資與請假系統升級維護
part6.header:
NOTICE: Scheduled HR Portal Maintenance
Saturday, July 19 | 10:00 P.M. – Sunday, July 20 | 4:00 A.M.
part6.body:
To improve loading speed and strengthen data encryption, the IT Department will perform a scheduled upgrade on the internal HR Portal this weekend. During the six-hour maintenance window, employees will not be able to log in to view pay stubs, submit leave requests, [13] update personal tax information.

All supervisors are asked to approve any pending overtime forms before 6:00 P.M. on Friday so that payroll processing is not [14]. [15]

Once the upgrade is complete, you will notice a cleaner dashboard layout and faster mobile access. [16] you encounter any login errors on Monday morning, please submit a support ticket to the IT Helpdesk at ext. 4400.

questions.explanation: 在否定句（will not be able to A, B, or C）中，列舉多項無法進行的動作時，連接詞應使用 or（無法查看薪資單、提出請假申請「或」更新個人稅務資料）。
so that payroll processing is not _______ 表達「以免薪資結算作業受到中斷／影響」，is not + 過去分詞構成被動語態，故選 disrupted。

options: Please return borrowed laptops to the reception desk by noon.
External vendors must wear visitor passes in the parking garage.
The office gym will extend its weekend hours starting in August.
All previously saved records and historical pay slips will remain safely intact.
questions.explanation: 系統維護前員工最擔心的就是原有紀錄遺失，緊接在提醒主管週五前簽核之後，補充說明「所有先前儲存的紀錄與歷史薪資單皆會完整保留」最符合 IT 維護公告語境。
原句為 If you should encounter...（萬一您在週一早上遇到任何登入錯誤…），省略 If 並將 Should 移至句首，後方接原形動詞 encounter。Had 需配 p.p.，Were 需配 to V/名詞/形容詞，Unless 語意相反。

part6.title: 年度經銷商策略峰會邀請函
part6.header:
Dear Valued Partner,
Apex Medical Devices Annual Distributor Summit
part6.body:
On behalf of Apex Medical Devices, I am delighted to invite you to our Annual Distributor Summit, taking place October 8–9 at the Grand Harbor Convention Center in Kaohsiung. This year's theme focuses on expanding minimally invasive diagnostic tools across emerging Asian hospitals.

Attendees will gain exclusive access to live product demonstrations and one-on-one consultations with our R&D specialists. [17] In addition, we will host an awards banquet on the evening of October 8 to honor our top-performing regional distributors.

Hotel accommodations at the adjacent Harbor View Hotel are available at a [18] corporate rate for registered guests. To take advantage of this special offer, please confirm your attendance [19] September 15. We are confident that your participation will contribute [20] to a productive and inspiring summit.

options: Customers may exchange defective items at any participating pharmacy.
Our Kaohsiung manufacturing facility was constructed thirty years ago.
Several workshops will also cover regulatory compliance and clinical training.
The monthly newsletter has been discontinued due to low readership.
questions.explanation: 本段都在介紹峰會的議程亮點（產品實機展示、研發專家一對一諮詢、頒獎晚宴），插入「數場工作坊也將涵蓋法規遵循與臨床培訓」完全扣合議程介紹。
企業優惠房價（corporate rate）是「被打折的、享有折扣的」，多益飯店與旅遊主題超高頻搭配：a discounted rate（優惠價格）。
confirm your attendance（確認出席）是一次性報名動作，搭配截止日期 September 15 必須用 by（在九月十五日前）。
空格用來修飾動詞 contribute（貢獻），contribute greatly to... 意為「對…做出極大貢獻」，故選副詞 greatly。

documents.label: 電子郵件
documents.header:
To: All Staff <all-staff@veritas-design.com>
From: Grace Yeh, Office Manager <g.yeh@veritas-design.com>
Date: March 4
Subject: Relocation to Xinyi Plaza & Parking Permits
documents.content:
Dear Team,

As announced at last month's town hall meeting, Veritas Design will officially relocate from our current Songshan office to the 14th floor of Xinyi Plaza on Monday, April 7. Moving boxes and color-coded floor labels will be delivered to each workstation on March 28. Please pack all personal items and label your monitors before leaving work on Friday, April 4. Professional movers will transport all labeled equipment over the weekend.

Please note that the IT team will disconnect desktop computers at 3:00 P.M. on April 4, so employees are encouraged to work from home during the afternoon if they have client deadlines.

Regarding transportation, Xinyi Plaza is a three-minute walk from Taipei 101/World Trade Center MRT Station (Exit 4). Employees who commute by car or scooter may apply for a subsidized monthly parking permit in Basement Level 3. Because spaces are limited to 45 vehicles, permits will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. To request a spot, complete the online Facilities Form by 5:00 P.M. on March 18.

If you have questions about ergonomic desk setups in the new space, please contact Alex Kuo in Operations.

Best regards,
Grace Yeh

questions.question: When will Veritas Design begin operating at Xinyi Plaza?
questions.explanation: 第一段第一句明確指出：Veritas Design will officially relocate... to the 14th floor of Xinyi Plaza on Monday, April 7（4 月 7 日週一正式搬遷啟用）。3 月 18 日是停車證申請截止日，3 月 28 日發箱子，4 月 4 日打包。

questions.question: Why are employees advised to consider working remotely on the afternoon of April 4?
options: The Songshan building will undergo electrical repairs.
The MRT station near the office will be closed temporarily.
Office desktop computers will be unplugged mid-afternoon.
A mandatory town hall meeting will take place online.
questions.explanation: 第二段說明：the IT team will disconnect desktop computers at 3:00 P.M. on April 4（IT 團隊將於 4 月 4 日下午三點拔除桌上型電腦電源／連線），對應選項 (C) unplugged mid-afternoon（同義替換 disconnect → unplug）。

questions.question: What is stated about parking permits at Xinyi Plaza?
options: They are completely free of charge for all employees.
They must be requested directly from Alex Kuo.
They are reserved exclusively for senior executives.
They are assigned in the order applications are received.
questions.explanation: 第三段指出 permits will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis（依先到先得順序分配），同義替換為 (D) in the order applications are received。注意 subsidized 是「有補助（並非完全免費）」，Alex Kuo 負責的是人體工學辦公桌配置。

questions.question: What should employees do by March 18 if they want a parking space?
options: Pick up moving boxes at the reception desk
Email their vehicle registration to Grace Yeh
Fill out an online Facilities Form
Visit Basement Level 3 to register in person
questions.explanation: 第三段最後一句明確寫道：To request a spot, complete the online Facilities Form by 5:00 P.M. on March 18（填寫線上總務表單）。

documents.label: 財經新聞
documents.header:
TAIWAN BUSINESS WEEKLY — October 14
BeanCraft Roasters Cuts Energy Waste With Smart Roasting Tech
documents.content:
TAICHUNG — BeanCraft Roasters, a specialty coffee chain operating 28 cafés across central and northern Taiwan, has reported a 22 percent drop in roasting energy consumption after installing sensor-guided roasters at its Taichung central facility six months ago.

Traditionally, master roasters relied heavily on manual temperature adjustments and visual inspections, which occasionally led to inconsistent flavor profiles between batches. The newly adopted machines continuously monitor bean moisture and airflow, automatically fine-tuning heat levels to guarantee consistent quality.

"Initially, some of our veteran roasters worried that automation would diminish the artisanal character of our coffee," said Operations VP Victor Chang. "Instead, the system handles repetitive thermal tracking, freeing our staff to focus on sourcing direct-trade beans from smallholder farms and crafting seasonal blends."

Encouraged by lower utility bills and a 15 percent rise in wholesale orders from boutique hotels, BeanCraft plans to open its first southern flagship store in Kaohsiung early next year and expand its online subscription service.

questions.question: What is the main focus of the article?
options: A shortage of coffee beans from smallholder farms
How new roasting technology benefited a Taiwanese coffee chain
Why BeanCraft decided to close its Taichung facility
A merger between a coffee chain and a boutique hotel group
questions.explanation: 全文圍繞 BeanCraft 導入智慧感測烘焙設備後，成功降低 22% 能源消耗、穩定品質、讓烘焙師專注於選豆與研發，並帶動批發訂單成長，故主旨為 (B)。

questions.question: What problem did BeanCraft occasionally face before upgrading its equipment?
options: Frequent shipping delays to northern Taiwan
High employee turnover among café baristas
A lack of space at its Kaohsiung flagship store
Uneven coffee taste from one batch to another
questions.explanation: 第二段指出舊有人工控溫 occasionally led to inconsistent flavor profiles between batches（偶爾導致不同批次間風味不一致），同義替換為 (D) Uneven coffee taste from one batch to another。

questions.question: According to Victor Chang, how did experienced roasters initially react to the upgrade?
options: They were concerned it might harm the craft quality of the coffee.
They immediately volunteered to relocate to Kaohsiung.
They complained that the machines were too noisy.
questions.explanation: 第三段引述 Victor Chang 的話：some of our veteran roasters worried that automation would diminish the artisanal character of our coffee（擔心自動化會削弱咖啡的手工職人風味），對應 (A)。

questions.question: What does BeanCraft plan to do early next year?
options: Discontinue its wholesale sales to hotels
Launch a new flagship location in southern Taiwan
Replace all café staff with automated kiosks
questions.explanation: 最後一段指出：BeanCraft plans to open its first southern flagship store in Kaohsiung early next year（計畫明年初在高雄開設首間南台灣旗艦店）。

CAREER OPPORTUNITY: Senior Supply Chain Analyst
Company: Formosa Precision Components (Hsinchu Science Park)
Employment Type: Full-Time | Hybrid (3 days on-site, 2 days remote)
documents.content:
About the Role:
Formosa Precision Components is seeking an experienced Senior Supply Chain Analyst to optimize raw material procurement and oversee vendor performance across Taiwan, Japan, and Vietnam.

Key Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
• Minimum of 4 years of experience in manufacturing logistics or ERP inventory planning.
• Proficiency in SQL and Excel data modeling; experience with SAP ERP is strongly preferred.
• Fluent written and spoken English (TOEIC 800+ or equivalent); conversational Japanese is a plus.

Benefits:
• Competitive salary commensurate with experience plus performance bonuses.
• Annual health checkup allowance and continuing education subsidies.

How to Apply:
Send your résumé and a cover letter highlighting a past cost-saving project to hr@formosa-precision.com by November 20. Please include the job code [SC-2026] in the email subject line.

To: hr@formosa-precision.com

Date: November 14
Subject: Application for Senior Supply Chain Analyst [SC-2026]
documents.content:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Supply Chain Analyst position at Formosa Precision Components. With six years of experience in electronics manufacturing logistics and a master's degree in Industrial Engineering, I am eager to contribute to your regional procurement strategy.

In my current role as a Logistics Specialist at Zenith Electronics in Taoyuan, I manage inventory forecasting using SAP ERP and SQL dashboards. Last year, I led a vendor consolidation initiative across twelve packaging suppliers that shortened average lead times by 18 percent and saved the company over NT$4.2 million annually.

Additionally, I regularly coordinate with overseas clients in English and recently achieved a TOEIC score of 895. While I do not currently speak Japanese, I have worked closely with component distributors in Vietnam and understand regional customs procedures well.

I have attached my résumé for your review and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my analytical background aligns with your team's goals. I am available for an interview at your convenience.

Sincerely,
Emily Huang
